high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from thehindu.com, dated June 22, 2025, at 8:12 PM IST. The article discusses Ms. Jahnavi's plans to undergo intensive astronaut training through Titan Space’s ASCAN programme over the next three years, starting from 2026. The training includes flight simulation, spacecraft procedures, survival training, medical and psychological evaluations. Ms. Jahnavi mentions that the Titans Space Orbital flight will last five hours, providing a uniquely transformative environment for scientific research and human spaceflight advancement.
